title: SPADER: Step-wise Peer Advantage with Diversity-Aware Exploration Rewards for Multi-Answer Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2606.00593v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented agents to acquire information beyond parametric knowledge. While recent work has improved long-horizon tool-use reasoning, most approaches focus on tasks with a single correct answer. In contrast, many real-world queries require discovering a comprehensive set of valid answers, a setting known as Multi-Answer QA. This setting raises two challenges: fine-grained credit assignment over long search trajectories and reward alignment for sustained exploration beyond easy high-frequency entities. translated_title: SPADER：基于步级同伴优势与多样性感知探索奖励的多答案问答方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.00593v3 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：大语言模型越来越多地被部署为工具增强的智能体，以获取超出其参数化知识之外的信息。尽管近期工作已改进了长时程工具使用推理，但大多数方法专注于仅有一个正确答案的任务。相比之下，许多现实世界的查询需要发现一组全面的有效答案，这种设置被称为多答案问答（Multi-Answer QA）。这一设置带来了两个挑战：一是对长搜索轨迹的细粒度信用分配，二是奖励对齐以支持超越简单高频实体的持续探索。我们提出了SPADER，一个面向多答案问答中长时程工具使用的强化学习框架。SPADER包含步级同伴优势（SPA）机制，这是一种无评论家的步级信用分配机制，通过决策步骤对齐并行轨迹，并从同伴回报中估计优势。此外，它还包含一个多样性感知的探索奖励，用以促进长尾实体……
tldr: SPADER提出了一种强化学习框架，通过无评论家的步级同伴优势机制实现细粒度信用分配，并结合多样性感知的探索奖励促进长尾实体发现，从而提升大语言模型在多答案问答中的长时程工具使用能力。
en_tdlr: SPADER is a reinforcement learning framework for multi-answer QA that enables fine-grained credit assignment via a critic-free step-wise peer advantage mechanism and encourages discovery of long-tail entities through diversity-aware exploration rewards, improving long-horizon tool use in large language models.
